role: Finds units whose code is alike, for `impact`'s same-code-elsewhere section: reduces each unit's code to tokens and 4-token runs and scores pairs by the rare runs they share. Imported by codemap.py (impact) and measure.py.
state: TOKEN: the token pattern (string literals, numbers, identifiers, operators and punctuation)
CAMEL: splits identifiers at camel case
toplevel: Module docstring, `from __future__ import annotations`, imports (collections, math, re), the three constants above and the Index class statement.

units.does: Tokens of a piece of code: // and /* */ comments removed (and, with hash_comments, # comments that start a line or follow whitespace), string literals become 'STR', numbers 'NUM', identifiers are split at camel case and lower-cased, other tokens kept as they are.
The set of 4-token runs (WIDTH) in the code's tokens; empty for fewer than 4 tokens.

Builds the run set of every given unit (# comments stripped for files other than .swift/.c/.m/.h), each run's rarity log(units / units having it), and, for runs that at most 50 units have, the list of units that have each.

The units sharing the largest rarity-weighted part of a node's runs: for every other unit that shares an indexed run, the shared weight divided by the larger of the two units' total weights; keeps those scoring at least `minimum` (default 0.35), best first, up to `limit` (default 15), scores rounded to 2 places. A unit whose total weight is under 25 (too little distinctive code) gets [].
Maps every unit of every non-Markdown file with units to its code (its start to end lines); a file that cannot be read is skipped.
